info.name: GameAnalytics REST APIs Collection Metrics API

params.name: metric
params.description: The metric to query (e.g. dau, mau, retention_retro, arpu, arppu, session_length).

items.docs: Returns aggregated metric data (for example `dau`, `mau`, `retention_retro`, `arpu`, `arppu`, `session_length`, `revenue`, `ad_revenue`) as JSON. Authenticated with the `X-API-Key` header. The body specifies an ISO-8601 `interval`, a `granularity`, an optional `game` id, and a `query` object of type `group`, `split`, or `timeseries`.
